{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2283_Objection2",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStruct_WithKeyedFieldAndIndexer_InReferencedAssembly_GeneratesResolver()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public struct KeyedFieldStruct<T>\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public T Value;\n                }\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public struct KeyedFieldAndIndexerStruct<T>\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public T Value;\n\n                    public T this[int index] => this.Value;\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using Lib;\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial class AppObject\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public KeyedFieldStruct<int> FieldStruct { get; set; }\n\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public KeyedFieldAndIndexerStruct<string> IndexerStruct;\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetBaseReferencesAsync();\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n        CSharpCompilationOptions compilationOptions = new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary);\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences,\n            compilationOptions);\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = EmitToMetadataReference(libCompilation);\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences.Add(libReference),\n            compilationOptions);\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult[] generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToArray();\n        Assert.Contains(generatedSources, s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\"));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> appDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(appDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(appDiagnostics);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStruct_WithUnkeyedField_InReferencedAssembly_ReportsDiagnosticInDefiningAssemblyOnly()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public struct UnkeyedFieldStruct<T>\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public T KeyedValue;\n\n                    public int UnkeyedField;\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using Lib;\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial class AppObject\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public UnkeyedFieldStruct<int> Member { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetBaseReferencesAsync();\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n        CSharpCompilationOptions compilationOptions = new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary);\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences,\n            compilationOptions);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> libDiagnostics = await libCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(libDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Contains(libDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"MsgPack004\" && d.GetMessage().Contains(\"UnkeyedField\"));\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = EmitToMetadataReference(libCompilation);\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences.Add(libReference),\n            compilationOptions);\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult[] generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToArray();\n        Assert.Contains(generatedSources, s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\"));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> appDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(appDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(appDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"MsgPack004\");\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<ImmutableArray<MetadataReference>> GetBaseReferencesAsync()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        return net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).ToImmutableArray();\n    }\n\n    private static MetadataReference EmitToMetadataReference(CSharpCompilation compilation)\n    {\n        using var stream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = compilation.Emit(stream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        return MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(stream.ToArray());\n    }\n}\n"
}
